scope: Unstaged local source-layout expansion, not a Go parser/compiler or model-quality gain. Owner review before commit.
runtime_consumer: Command.source_units -> native_structure.ranges(go=True), used by explicit Go units in both workflows
problem: The previous conservative guard refused any func token in Go result syntax, preventing selection of legitimate callback factories.
intervention: Recognize one bounded returned function type with balanced parameters and void/simple named/pointer/slice result. Keep anonymous struct/interface, receiver/generic, complex tuple and declaration/body ambiguity refusals.
limits: Source bounds and lexical identity verified; types and runtime semantics are not compiler-checked.
No global support for all Go callbacks or return types.
Enabling evidence does not approve generated prose.
